的.def: aim, goal; of; possessive particle; -self suffix

origin.says: First written 旳: 日 (sun) for 'bright' plus 勺 (ladle) as the sound; 日 later became 白 (white). The bright center of a target followed, and the common grammar word 'of' was written with it for its sound.

的.name: of

是.def: to be; indeed, right, yes; okay

ety.hint: To speak 日 directly 疋

origin.says: Bronze forms show 日 (sun) over a foot shape like 正 (straight, correct); the first meaning was 'right, this'. The picture is debated, and the meaning 'to be' came later.

是.name: is

在.def: at, in, on; to exist; used to indicate the present progressive tense

ety.hint: earth

origin.says: At first 才 (talent; a stake) was borrowed for 'to be at'; then 士 (scholar) was added as a second sound part, and it later changed shape into 土 (earth). Meaning: to be at, exist.

在.name: be at

了.def: clear; to finish; particle of completed action

ety.hint: A child swaddled in blanklets; compare 子

origin.says: Origin unclear: one old reading sees a child without arms, like 子 (child) cut short, another tangled legs. Its use as the grammar word for finished likely comes by sound loan; it also stands for 瞭 (clear-sighted).

了.name: finished

ety.hint: A bird flying toward the sky 一

origin.says: Old forms are usually read as a drawing of a flower's calyx (or a root under the ground line). That meaning was lost and the sign was borrowed for the sound of the word 'not'.

有.def: to have, to own, to possess; to exist

origin.says: A hand (now 𠂇, from 又 (hand), which also gave the sound) holding a piece of meat (now the moon-like ⺝, really 肉 (meat)): holding meat, to have, to possess.

有.name: have

ety.hint: Represents heaven (天), earth (旦), or the number 1

origin.says: A single horizontal stroke, a tally mark for one.

一.name: one
一.in: 是行得但定同题合应给或提完候量师命院元查验演玩德远担拿宣域险副善园答富画街签武福输检贵灭逼脸遗污援碍哈幅旦偷冠搭塔缓跨坦

ety.hint: A hand 扌 holding a weapon 戈

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms draw a weapon with a saw-toothed or three-pronged blade on a long shaft, related to 戈 (dagger-axe). The word for 'I' sounded the same, so the picture was borrowed for it.

ety.hint: The legs of a human being

origin.says: Draws a person standing in profile, an arm and a leg showing.

人.name: person
人.in: 以会从全合给认队命价众企除验创拿似险答介签阶输检余枪坐喝脸途座抢哈黎偷啥搭龄拟塔茶愈舒翰揭绘碎珍剑纵诊涂醉闪渴舍叙愉仓趁

为.def: to do, to act; to handle, to govern; to be

origin.says: Traditional 爲 shows a hand leading an elephant: putting an animal to work, so to do, to act, to be. The simplified 为 comes from a cursive form.

为.name: do

origin.says: Simplified from 這: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 言 (speech) as the sound; it first meant 'to meet' and was borrowed for 'this' around the Tang. The simplified form writes 文 (writing) in place of 言.

ety.hint: Treasure 玉 within a country's borders 囗

origin.says: Simplified from 國: 或 (戈 a weapon guarding 口 a territory) inside 囗 (a border), a defended state. The simplified form puts 玉 (jade) inside 囗, a variant already used long before.

中.def: central; center, middle; amidst; to hit (target), to attain; China; Chinese

ety.hint: A line 丨 through the center of a box 口

origin.says: A picture of a pole set up in the middle of a camp or field, with a box in its middle (one reading: a drum, another: a target). It marks the centre.

中.name: middle
中.in: 种冲钟贵遗忠谴溃遣肿衷馈仲

个.def: this, that; single; measure word for individuals

ety.hint: A tally 丨 of people 人

origin.says: One stalk of bamboo, half of 竹 (bamboo), a variant of 箇 (bamboo stalk) used as a counting word. The other traditional form 個 is 亻 (person) plus 固 (solid) as the sound.

个.name: one stalk

们.def: plural marker for pronouns and some nouns

ety.hint: people

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 门 (gate) as the sound: a late character marking the plural of people and pronouns. Simplified from 們, with 門 written 门.

们.name: plural people

ety.hint: An additional, "also" 也  person 亻

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 也 (also) as the sound, a later form of 佗 (person + 它): first 'other, another', later 'he'.

ety.hint: mouth

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 禾 (grain) as the sound: voices answering in tune, harmony; later also 'and'. It replaced the older 龢, which drew a set of pan pipes.

来.def: to arrive, to come, to return; in the future, later on

ety.hint: A wheat plant that has not yet borne fruit; compare 來

origin.says: Simplified from 來, a picture of a wheat plant with ears and roots. The word 'come' sounded the same and borrowed the picture; 麥 (wheat) took over the plant.

来.name: come

要.def: essential, necessary; to ask for; to coerce; to demand

ety.hint: A woman 女 with hands on her waist 覀

origin.says: A person, later drawn as 女 (woman), with two hands at the waist; the head and hands became 覀. It first meant waist, then was borrowed for want, need, and 腰 was made for waist.

要.name: want

以.def: according to; so as to; because of; then

origin.says: Origin debated: the old form is read as a plow-like tool, or as a person (人, still visible on the right) carrying something; the word meant 'to take, use', now 'by means of'.

以.name: by means

会.def: to assemble, to meet; meeting; association, group

ety.hint: People 人 speaking 云

origin.says: Simplified from 會 (meet), whose origin is unclear (one reading: a lidded vessel, lid fitting body; another: 合 (join) plus a sound part). 会 comes from an old cursive variant, now looking like 人 (person) over 云 (cloud).

会.name: meeting

ety.hint: A man 干 carrying grain, representing the annual harvest

origin.says: Early forms show a person 人 (person) carrying harvested grain 禾 (grain): the harvest, which comes once a year, hence year. 人 (later 千, thousand) may also give the sound. The parts have fused and are no longer visible.

ety.hint: arrive

origin.says: 至 (arrive) for the meaning plus 刂 (knife) as the sound: to arrive. In bronze forms the right side was a person, later written as the knife.

上.def: above, on top, superior; to go up; to attend; previous

ety.hint: One stroke on top of another; compare 下 (below)

origin.says: A short mark above a longer base line, pointing to what is above; the upright stroke was added to keep it apart from 二 (two). Contrast 下 (below).

上.name: up

ety.hint: A pair 又 of hands 寸

origin.says: Simplified from 對, a hand (later 寸 (hand)) holding a digging tool over earth; borrowed for 'to reply, facing, correct'. The complex left half was replaced by 又 (hand).

ety.hint: day

origin.says: Simplified from 時: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 寺 (temple) as the sound (the earliest forms used 之 (to go) as the sound). The simplified form keeps only the 寸 of 寺.

ety.hint: A man 人 with outstretched arms

origin.says: A drawing of a grown person standing face-on with arms and legs spread: 'big'. One reading stresses the outstretched arms, another just a standing adult.

大.name: big
大.in: 因美类参达模奖澳奇套庆幕奋烟骑夺奥跨衡姻莫摸掩寄尖奔恩夸惨漠牵寞墓渗慕契奈奠淹椅膜攀奢溪垮募爽咽懊挎暮夯驮叁茵倚俺捺掺崎

origin.says: From 麼: 幺 (tiny) for the meaning plus 麻 (hemp) as the sound, used for the question particle. The simplified form drops 麻 (hemp), keeping a variant of 幺 (tiny thread).

ety.hint: Pronoun 尔 for a person 亻

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus 尔 (old word for 'you'), which also gives the sound: the everyday 'you', a later colloquial form of 爾.

就.def: just, simply; to go to; to approach, near

ety.hint: specialty

origin.says: 京 (a tall building on a high mound) plus 尤 (especially): going toward a high place, hence 'approach, go to', and later 'just, at once'. The role of 尤 is disputed.

就.name: approach

能.def: can, may; capable, full of energy

ety.hint: A bear's head 厶, body ⺼, and claws 匕

origin.says: A picture of a bear: head with mouth on top, body (now like 月 'moon/flesh') and two pairs of paws (like 匕 'spoon'). The word was borrowed for the sound-alike 'can, able', and 熊 (bear) added fire dots for the animal.

能.name: able bear

origin.says: Origin unclear: one reading sees a crying child with open mouth, others a snake, a pouring vessel, or female parts. It survives as a borrowed function word, 'also'.

ety.hint: vigorous

origin.says: 口 (mouth) plus a hooked shape 丂 for the sound: one reading sees an axe handle (now 柯, handle) used for its sound, the mouth showing it is only spoken. A voice of approval: can, may.

可.name: can
可.in: 何啊歌奇哥河阿骑荷寄椅呵坷苛倚崎畸

说.def: to speak, to say; to scold, to upbraid

ety.hint: speech

origin.says: Simplified from 說: 言 (speech, shortened to 讠) for the meaning plus 兑 (exchange; first 'speech') as the sound: to speak, explain. 說 once also wrote 'pleased'.

说.name: speak

于.def: at, in, on; to, from; alas!

origin.says: One reading draws a wind instrument, another is unsure; the sign was borrowed for the word 'at, in, from'. As a simplified form it also replaces 於 (once a variant of 烏, crow), which had taken over the same use.

于.name: at

与.def: and; with; to; for; to give, to grant

origin.says: Traditional 與 shows hands joined (舁, hands lifting) with 牙 (tooth) as a sound part: to give, to join with. The simplified form takes over 与, an old separate character meaning 'to give'.

与.name: with

origin.says: Originally 'ruler, queen', perhaps a person giving orders with 口 (mouth); its origin is unclear. In simplification it also took over 後 (behind, after; a foot held back by a cord), which sounds the same.

发.def: to issue, to dispatch, to send out; hair

origin.says: One simplified form for two characters: 發 (shoot, send out; feet, 弓 (bow) and a hand) and 髮 (hair; 髟 (long hair) plus a sound part). The shape comes from a cursive way of writing them.

发.name: send out

ety.hint: A shoot 屮 growing in the soil 土

origin.says: The oracle-bone form draws a sprout (屮) pushing up out of the ground (a line 一): growing, to be born, alive, raw.

生.name: life
生.in: 性星胜醒姓牲腥隆猩笙甥窿

出.def: to go out, to send out; stand; produce

ety.hint: A sprout 屮 growing out of a container 凵

origin.says: Early forms show 止 (foot) stepping out of 凵 (a pit or doorway): to go out, exit. The shape later fused into one form; one old reading wrongly saw a plant growing out.

出.name: go out
出.in: 础崛掘屈倔拙茁咄祟窟

地.def: earth, ground, soil; land, region; structural particle used before a verb

ety.hint: earth

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 也 (also) as the sound: the earth, the ground.

地.name: ground

过.def: pass; to go across, to pass through

ety.hint: walk

origin.says: Simplified from 過: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 咼 (crooked mouth) as the sound: to pass by, to cross. 咼 was replaced by 寸 (inch), from cursive writing.

过.name: pass by

成.def: to accomplish; to become; to complete, to finish; to succeed

origin.says: A broad-bladed axe 戊 (axe) with 丁 (nail) as the sound, perhaps first 'city walls' defended by weapons (now 城, city wall). It came to mean 'complete, become'. The 丁 has merged into the axe strokes.

成.name: accomplish

都.def: all, each, entirely, whole; metropolis; capital

ety.hint: city

origin.says: 者 as the sound plus 阝 (from 邑, town) for the meaning: a capital, a large city. The meaning 'all' (read dōu) is a later borrowed use.

都.name: capital all

ety.hint: roof

origin.says: 宀 (roof) over a pig: oracle forms had a boar as the sound part, which later became 豕 (pig); one reading instead sees a pig kept under the roof. The meaning is house, home, family; 傢 (furniture) was merged into it.

没.def: not, none, gone; to bury; to sink, to drown

ety.hint: water

origin.says: From 沒: 氵 (water) plus a hand reaching down into a whirl, 'to sink, drown'. The right part now looks like 殳 (weapon hand). The common sense 'not have' is a spoken word borrowed onto it, unrelated to drowning.

没.name: sunk

现.def: to appear, to manifest; current, now

ety.hint: To see 见 jade 王; 见 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 現, a late character: 𤣩 (玉 jade) + 见 (see) as sound and meaning: the gleam of jade showing, hence to appear, present. Simplification uses 见 for 見.

现.name: appear

行.def: to go, to walk, to move; professional

ety.hint: To take small steps 亍 with one's feet 彳

origin.says: A drawing of a crossroads, first meaning 'road', then 'to go'. It was once symmetrical; the halves now look like 彳 (step) and 亍 (small step).

行.name: crossroads

用.def: to use, to employ, to apply; use

origin.says: Origin disputed: often read as a drawing of a bucket with a handle, others see a bell or a form of 同 (same) with a handle. It was used for the word 'to use' by sound.

用.name: use
用.in: 通拥痛勇涌佣桶踊诵捅

学.def: learning, knowledge, science; to study, to go to school; -ology

ety.hint: A building 冖 where children 子 study; ⺍ provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 學: two hands around 爻 (crossed counting sticks), over a roof-like cover and 子 (child): a child being taught. The busy top was replaced by a cursive shorthand of three dots over a cover.

学.name: study

还.def: also, besides; still, yet; to return

ety.hint: Not 不 moving 辶

origin.says: Simplified from 還: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 睘 as the sound, to return. The simplified form replaces 睘 with 不 (not), a handwriting shorthand that is not a sound part.

还.name: still more

ety.hint: A nose; in China, people refer to themselves by pointing to their noses

origin.says: A drawing of a nose, the original of 鼻 (nose). Borrowed for 'self, from' by sound; folk etymology links it to pointing at one's nose to mean 'me'.

ety.hint: The sun

origin.says: A picture of the sun: a circle with a dot or stroke in the middle; hence also a day.

日.name: sun
日.in: 是时都得但最间题意提者明影量指香照查增境曾显音易模错复简早担星宣晚韩著婚章普景竟温阳旧障暴草爆盟遭智漫慢唱喝醒混掉春昨询

得.def: to obtain, to get, to acquire; suitable, proper; ready

ety.hint: A hand 寸 grabbing a shell 旦

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms show a hand (又) grabbing a cowrie shell (貝, money): to get. 彳 (road) was added later; the shell turned into the 旦-like shape and the hand into 寸 (thumb).

得.name: obtain

作.def: to make; to write, to compose; to act, to perform

ety.hint: A person 亻 making something for the first time 乍; 乍 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Originally just 乍 (an old drawing meaning "to make"); 亻 (person) was added for a person doing the work, and 乍 now gives the sound: to make, to do, to write.

作.name: make

经.def: the classics; to experience, to undergo

ety.hint: thread

origin.says: Simplified from 經: 糸 (silk thread) plus 巠 (warp threads on a loom) as sound and picture: the lengthwise warp, then 'pass through' and 'classic text'. 纟 and the right side are shorthands.

经.name: warp thread

而.def: and, and then, and yet; but

origin.says: A drawing of a beard hanging from the chin. It was borrowed for its sound to write the little word and / but, and the beard meaning moved to other characters.

而.name: beard
而.in: 需端耐瑞耍喘儒懦揣斋蠕糯

ety.hint: mouth

origin.says: A late character for the spoken question word: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 马 (horse) as the sound. Simplified from 嗎, 馬 shortened to 马.

下.def: below, underneath; inferior; to bring down; next

ety.hint: One stroke under another; compare 上 (above)

origin.says: An abstract sign: a short mark below a long line, meaning below; the vertical stroke was added later to tell it from 二 (two).

下.name: below

开.def: to open; to start, to initiate, to begin

ety.hint: Simplified form of 開; hands 廾 lifting the latch 一 of a door

origin.says: Simplified from 開 (open): 門 (door) with a bar and two hands lifting it off. The simplified form drops the door and keeps only the bar and the hands.

开.name: open
开.in: 并形研型刑拼瓶屏饼荆

法.def: law, rule, statute; method, way; French

ety.hint: The course 去 followed by a stream 氵

origin.says: Short for the old 灋: 氵 (water), 廌 (a mythical goat that judged the guilty) and a part read as the sound; the goat was dropped, leaving 氵 plus 去 (to go). Law flows level like water and sends away the wrong.

法.name: law

ety.hint: A crescent moon

origin.says: A drawing of the crescent moon; the moon's cycle also gave the meaning month.

月.name: moon
月.in: 期明服望朋股脑胜赢盟脱脸胁朝湖朗脚胞腿胡肥腊潮脏肤阴塑脉胆脆胸糊胎崩胀膨肌胖脾膀肚肺肿胶脖腥腰钥嘲腾蝴脂膜膝肪肠霸肝溯腕

多.def: much, many, multi-; more than, over

ety.hint: Two nights 夕, suggesting many

origin.says: Two pieces of meat stacked: plenty, many. In bronze inscriptions the meat shape came to look like 夕 (evening), so the character now reads as two 夕; it has nothing to do with evenings.

多.name: many

origin.says: Origin unclear. Early forms have been read as a plough, a person in a neck yoke, or a boat-like shape; the meanings 'side, square, direction' came later.

方.name: square
方.in: 游放施族房旅激防访邀仿旁旗旋妨榜纺镑膀缴磅肪傍谤敷螃愣坊芳簇淤

动.def: to move, to happen; movement, action

ety.hint: strength

origin.says: From 動: 力 (strength) for the meaning plus 重 (heavy) as the sound: using strength to move something. The simplified form replaces 重 with 云 (cloud) as a simple stand-in.

动.name: move

好.def: good, excellent, fine; proper, suitable; well

ety.hint: A woman 女 with a son 子

origin.says: 女 (woman) next to 子 (child): a woman with her child, meaning good or fine.

好.name: good

看.def: to look, to see; to examine, to scrutinize

ety.hint: Shielding one's eyes 目 with a hand 手 to look to the distance

origin.says: A hand 手 (hand), squeezed on top, held above an eye 目 (eye), as when shading the eyes to look into the distance: to look.

看.name: shaded eyes

分.def: to divide, to allocate; fraction; small unit of time or other quantity

ety.hint: Pieces 八 being further subdivided with a knife 刀

origin.says: 八 (two things parting) over 刀 (knife): cutting something apart with a knife, to divide; then a part, a fraction, a minute.

分.name: divide
分.in: 份粉贫纷颁扮氛盼盆吩芬掰岔寡忿

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 旦 (dawn) as the sound; first 'to bare the upper body' (now 袒, bare), then borrowed for 'only, but'.

里.def: unit of distance equal to 0.5km; village; lane

ety.hint: Unit of measure for farm 田 land 土

origin.says: 田 (field) over 土 (earth): land with fields where people settle, a village, then a unit of distance. In simplification it also took over 裏/裡 'inside', which were 衣 (clothing) + 里 as the sound.

里.name: village
里.in: 理量童野撞埋厘缠墅狸幢鲤哩瞳

事.def: affair, matter, business; to serve; accident, incident

origin.says: A hand 又 (hand) holding a pole with a flag or tool, from the same old form as 史 (record) and 吏 (official): doing one's assigned job, hence affair, matter.

事.name: matter

origin.says: 冄 (whiskers, now the bent left part) as the sound plus 阝 (from 邑 town) for the meaning: first the name of a state; its use for that is a sound loan.
A drawing of a winnowing basket, later with a stand added below; borrowed for its sound as the pronoun 'his, its, their'. The basket is now written 箕.

其.name: its
其.in: 期基斯甚旗欺堪棋撕勘斟簸箕嘶

所.def: place, location; "that which", a particle introducing a passive clause

ety.hint: An axe 斤 swung at a door 户

origin.says: 戶 (door) as the sound plus 斤 (axe) for the meaning: first said to be the sound of chopping wood, then borrowed for 'place' and as a grammar word. The door part has lost its exact shape.

所.name: place

之.def: marks preceding phrase as modifier of following phrase; it, him her, them; to go to

ety.hint: A foot meaning "to follow"; cursive version of 止

origin.says: A foot (止) above a line (一) marking the starting place: to go. In the modern shape the foot has become a dot and strokes, so the parts no longer show. Its main use as the grammar word of is a sound loan.

之.name: go to

ety.hint: To divide 八 what is private 厶

origin.says: Traditionally 八 (divide, turn away) over 厶 (private): the opposite of private, 'public'. Another reading takes the oracle form as a drawing of a jar, with 'public' a sound loan; the lower part was a small 口 shape, not 厶.

ety.hint: A file of ten 十 people 亻

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus 十 (ten): a squad of ten men, then mixed, assorted. Borrowed for its sound in 什么 (what).

当.def: appropriate, timely; to act, to serve; the sound of bells

origin.says: Simplified from 當: 尚 (still) as the sound plus 田 (field), first fields matching in value, hence to match, to act as. The simplification keeps the top dots and puts a cursive shorthand below.

当.name: serve as

ety.hint: cloth

origin.says: 衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 皮 (skin) as the sound: a quilt. From 'covered by' it became the marker of the passive, 'by'.

如.def: as, as if, like, such as, supposing

ety.hint: A wife 女 following her husband's words 口

origin.says: 女 (woman) as the sound plus 口 (mouth): a word meaning 'so, like, as if'. An older reading takes it as a wife following her husband's words.

如.name: as if

ety.hint: two

origin.says: 此 (this) with 二 (two) below; a late character for 'some, a few'. How it was formed is unclear; 此 may give the sound.

定.def: to decide, to fix, to settle; to order; definite, fixed, sure

ety.hint: A person 疋 settling under a roof 宀

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 正 (upright) as the sound, its bottom stroke bent in this position: settled under a roof, fixed, decided.

定.name: settle

ety.hint: A tree 木 with its roots highlighted

origin.says: 木 (tree) with an extra stroke marking its bottom: the root, hence origin, basis.

A person 大 (big, a person) lying on a mat 囗 (enclosure): the original meaning was 'mat', later written 茵. The meanings 'because, cause' were borrowed for the sound. One reading sees a person in clothing instead.

ety.hint: tree

origin.says: Simplified from 樣: 木 (tree) plus 羕 as the sound, first the acorn; borrowed for 'pattern, shape'. The new form uses 羊 (sheep) as the sound part.

关.def: frontier pass; to close, to shut; relation

origin.says: Simplified from 關: 門 (gate) plus a sound part showing the bar bolting the gate, hence to close and a frontier pass. The simple form dropped 門 and kept a cursive outline of the inner part.

关.name: gate bar

进.def: to advance, to make progress; to come in, to enter

ety.hint: walk

origin.says: From 進: 辶 (walk) plus 隹 (bird), a bird only walks forward, hence 'advance'. The 1956 simplification replaced 隹 by 井 (well) as a sound part.

进.name: advance

业.def: business, profession; to study, to work

origin.says: Simplified from 業, cut to its top part. 業 may draw a beam for hanging bells, or a person lifting it; the origin is unclear. Means work, trade, studies.

业.name: trade

origin.says: First written 歬: 止 (foot) on 舟 (boat), moving forward. A 刀 (knife) was added to make a word for 'to cut', but this form took over 'front', so 'to cut' got 剪 (scissors). The foot is now 䒑 and the boat 月.

ety.hint: Sharing a common 凡 tongue 口

origin.says: Probably a drawing of a tube or bucket (the frame) with 口 (mouth) added, the original form of 筒 (tube); used for together, the same. Other readings see people lifting something together.

ety.hint: script

origin.says: 正 (upright) as the sound and meaning plus 攵 (strike, action) for the meaning: making things right by action, governing.

主.def: to own; to host; master; host; lord

ety.hint: A lamp 王 with a flame 丶

origin.says: A picture of a lamp or torch with its flame on top (later written 炷); old forms of a spirit tablet and of burning wood merged into it too. Borrowed for its sound to mean master, owner, main.

主.name: master

等.def: rank, grade; same, equal; to wait

ety.hint: Bamboo strips ⺮ laid before a court 寺

origin.says: ⺮ (bamboo, the writing slips) plus 寺 as the sound: slips trimmed to even length, hence 'equal, rank, grade'. 'Wait' is a later borrowed use. One source reads 寺 as meaning instead.

等.name: wait in line

ety.hint: To take place 取 under the sun 日 (that is, everywhere)

origin.says: First 㝡: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 取 (take) as the sound, 'to gather'. The top later changed shape to 冃 (headcloth) and now 日; the sense became 'most'.

去.def: to go away, to leave, to depart

origin.says: Old forms show a person 大 (big man) above an opening 口 (mouth), perhaps a doorway, pit or the body's opening, read as leaving: 'to go away'. The parts later changed shape into 土 (earth) and 厶 (private), which have nothing to do with it.

去.name: go away

子.def: son, child; seed, egg; fruit; small thing

ety.hint: A child in a wrap, with outstretched arms but bundled legs

origin.says: A drawing of a baby: a big head, two waving arms, and the legs wrapped together in swaddling.

子.name: child
子.in: 学好教游孩字存享李熟季荐孕孤敦仔厚孙孔猛脖逊吼俘酵浮廓乳孝哮勃郭淳孟孵籽悖谆渤锰墩醇孽

ety.hint: fire

origin.says: 灬 (fire) for the meaning plus 肰 (dog meat: meat and 犬 dog) as the sound: to burn. It was borrowed for so, like that, and 燃 (burn) was made for the old meaning. The meat part now looks like 夕 (evening) with an extra stroke.
Simplified from 實: 宀 (roof) over carved jade and 貝 (shells), wealth filling a house, hence solid, real. The simplified form replaces the lower part with 头 (head).

ety.hint: A person 大 wearing an elegant crown 羊

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms show a person 大 (big, a standing man) wearing a headdress of feathers or horns, now written like 羊 (sheep): an adorned person, beautiful. An older reading took it as 'a big sheep tastes good'.

并.def: to combine, to annex; also, what's more

ety.hint: Simplified form of 並; two men standing side-by-side

origin.says: The old 幷 showed two people joined together; the simplified 并 also stands for 並 (two people standing side by side) and 併 (to merge). Its modern shape no longer shows the people.

并.name: side by side

将.def: the future, what will be; ready, prepared; a general

ety.hint: Going to bed 丬 at night 夕, a predictable future

origin.says: From 將: 爿 (low table) as the sound, with ⺼ (meat) and 寸 (hand): a hand offering meat; it came to mean to take, lead, a general, and 'will'. 爿 was cut to ⺦.

将.name: about to
